# ReceiptLedger – Web Operations Console & Dashboard Design Brief

**Target Audience:** Web Dashboard Engineer, Full-Stack Developer & UI Designer  
**Monorepo Location:** `web/` (React 18 + Vite 5 / Tailwind-free Vanilla CSS or Clean Component System)  
**Backend API Gateway:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`  
**Swagger Interactive Docs:** `http://localhost:8000/docs`  
**Primary Role:** Administrative Operations, Spending Intelligence, AI Telemetry & Human-in-the-Loop Review Desk  

---

## 1. System Role & Architecture Overview

The Web Dashboard serves as the **central desktop operations, audit, and financial intelligence console** for ReceiptLedger. While the mobile client (`mobile/`) handles quick on-the-go receipt photography, the desktop web console provides high-detail verification, audit logging, and observability for household finances or business bookkeeping.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                    FASTAPI BACKEND GATEWAY                                       │
│                                      (http://localhost:8000)                                     │
└──────────────▲──────────────────────────────────────▲─────────────────────────────────────▲──────┘
               │                                      │                                     │
   ┌───────────┴──────────┐               ┌───────────┴───────────┐             ┌───────────┴──────────┐
   │    MOBILE CLIENT     │               │     WEB DASHBOARD     │             │    OBSERVABILITY     │
   │  (Flutter - Capture) │               │   (Desktop Triage)    │             │ (Run Logs & Auditing)│
   └──────────────────────┘               └───────────────────────┘             └──────────────────────┘
```

### Core Responsibilities:
1. **Telemetry & System Health:** Live monitoring of Gemini AI Vision, Cloud Vision quota, local OCR fallbacks, and database persistence mode.
2. **Human-in-the-Loop Verification Desk:** Rapid desktop triage interface pairing cropped receipt photos with low-confidence OCR candidates.
3. **Historical Ingestion Ledger:** Searchable, paginated audit grid with item drill-downs, perceptual duplicate hashes, and OCR latency stats.
4. **Macro Financial Analytics:** Category-wise spending breakdowns, monthly trajectory velocity, and exportable financial reports.
5. **Observability Console:** Historical batch evaluation logs and model accuracy metrics (`/api/v1/system/runs`).

## 2. Desktop Viewport & Layout Architecture

The desktop dashboard must be optimized for wide viewports (1280px to 1920px+). It avoids unnecessary nesting or cluttered menus, organizing operations into clear visual zones:

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Desktop_Console ["Desktop Viewport (1280px+ Fixed-Fluid Layout)"]
        TopBar["Top Bar: Branding Logo | Engine Status Pills | Quick Action Controls | User Avatar & Session"]
        
        subgraph KPIRow ["Macro Telemetry Strip"]
            KPI1["Total Ingested: 148 Receipts (+14%)"]
            KPI2["Total Spend: PKR 184,250 (-6.35%)"]
            KPI3["Pending Review: 7 Items (Action Needed)"]
            KPI4["Model Accuracy: 96.2% Confidence"]
        end
        
        subgraph Workspaces ["Operational Workspace (Split / Tabbed)"]
            subgraph ReviewDesk ["Human-in-the-Loop Triage Desk (50% / 50% Split)"]
                Canvas["Left Pane: High-Res Receipt Canvas<br/>• Pan & Zoom Controls<br/>• Bounding-Box Overlay<br/>• Active Crop Highlighting"]
                TriageForm["Right Pane: Verification Form<br/>• Merchant & Line Item Input<br/>• Qty, Unit, Unit Price, Total<br/>• Confidence Score Pill<br/>• [Accept (Enter)] | [Edit (Ctrl+S)]"]
            end
            
            subgraph IngestionLedger ["Searchable Ingestion Audit Ledger"]
                FilterBar["Search Bar ('/') | Type Filter | Date Picker | Duplicate Filter"]
                Grid["High-Density Paginated Table (ID, Store, Date, Total, Engine, Status)"]
                Drawer["Slide-Out Drawer: Full JSON Payload | Raw OCR Text | Perceptual Hashes"]
            end
        end
        
        subgraph BottomZone ["Financial Intelligence & Telemetry Hub"]
            DonutChart["Category Spend Donut Breakdown"]
            TrendBars["Monthly Trajectory Velocity Bar Chart"]
            RunLogs["Observability Benchmark Logs (/system/runs)"]
        end
    end
    
    TopBar --> KPIRow
    KPIRow --> Workspaces
    Workspaces --> BottomZone
```

### Viewport Proportions & Layout Specifications:
* **Top Header (64px height, sticky top):**
  * Left: ReceiptLedger brand mark + active environment pill (`DEVELOPMENT` / `PRODUCTION`).
  * Center: Engine status badges: Gemini AI (`ok`), Google Cloud Vision (`quota=950`), Supabase DB (`connected`).
  * Right: Quick Actions (`[Seed Demo Data]`, `[Export CSV]`) + User Avatar (`Asad Khan`).
* **KPI Metrics Ribbon (110px height):**
  * 4 high-contrast metric cards with large figures and color-coded delta indicators.
* **Dual Operational Workspace (Main Area):**
  * **Tab 1: Human-in-the-Loop Review Desk:** Dedicated split-screen triage workspace (50% receipt viewer, 50% verification form).
  * **Tab 2: Ingestion Audit Ledger:** Searchable grid with slide-out drawer on row click.
* **Analytics & Observability Ribbon (Collapsible Bottom Section):**
  * Category breakdown donut, spending trend velocity, and batch run log inspector.

## 3. The Human-in-the-Loop Review Desk (Wireframe & Workflow)

The Review Desk is the crown jewel of the desktop console. When receipt scans have low OCR confidence (< 85%), line items are flagged for human verification.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Review_Desk_Split_Screen ["Human-in-the-Loop Review Desk (Split Viewport)"]
        direction LR
        subgraph Left_Canvas ["Left 50%: High-Res Receipt Inspector"]
            ImageCanvas["[Receipt Paper Canvas]<br/>• Scaled physical receipt image<br/>• Interactive Pan & Zoom (100% - 400%)<br/>• Glowing 2px bounding box around active snippet"]
        end
        
        subgraph Right_Triage ["Right 50%: Rapid Verification & Correction Form"]
            Header["Unresolved Items Queue: 7 pending"]
            Store["Merchant: Chaudhry Sabzi & Fruit Store"]
            ItemName["Candidate Name: [ Sweet Melon             ]"]
            Numbers["Qty: [ 0.64 ]  Unit: [ kg ]  Price: [ 199.0 ]"]
            Total["Calculated Total: PKR 127.36"]
            Conf["Confidence Badge: 74.5% (Check Item Name)"]
            Actions["Keyboard Actions:<br/>• [Confirm & Accept (Enter)]<br/>• [Save Edits (Ctrl+S)]<br/>• [Flag as Duplicate (Del)]"]
        end
    end
```

### Triage Ergonomics:
1. **Side-by-Side Verification:** The operator looks at the actual receipt text on the left and confirms or edits the values on the right.
2. **One-Key Approval:** Hitting `Enter` approves the item immediately (`action: "ACCEPTED"`), sends `PATCH /api/v1/review-queue/<built-in function id>`, and automatically advances to the next pending item.
3. **Inline Edit Mode:** Hitting `Tab` jumps into candidate text fields; hitting `Ctrl + S` commits modifications (`action: "EDITED"`).
4. **Zero Mouse Dependency:** A trained operator can triage dozens of ambiguous receipt items in under 60 seconds completely via keyboard.

## 5. Receipt Ingestion, Deduplication & Triage Pipeline

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Mobile / Operator
    participant API as FastAPI Gateway (:8000)
    participant Pipe as Preprocessing & OCR Router
    participant Dedupe as Deduplication Engine
    participant DB as SQLite / Supabase Ledger
    actor Desk as Desktop Review Desk

    User->>API: POST /api/v1/receipts/upload (image file)
    API->>Pipe: OpenCV contrast normalization + deskew
    Pipe->>Dedupe: Calculate SHA256 & pHash (64-bit)
    alt Exact SHA256 or pHash Hamming dist <= 4
        Dedupe-->>API: 409 Conflict (Duplicate Receipt Detected)
        API-->>User: Show duplicate warning with link to existing receipt
    else Unique Receipt
        Pipe->>Pipe: Execute Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite / Cloud Vision
        Pipe->>Pipe: Extract line items, quantities, and confidence scores
        alt All items confidence >= 85%
            Pipe->>DB: Save with status = 'PROCESSED'
            DB-->>API: 200 OK (Instant verified ledger entry)
        else Any item confidence < 85%
            Pipe->>DB: Save receipt as 'PENDING_REVIEW'
            Pipe->>DB: Insert candidates into Review Queue ('UNRESOLVED')
            DB-->>API: 200 OK (Flagged for review)
        end
    end

    Note over Desk,DB: Operator opens Desktop Review Desk
    Desk->>API: GET /api/v1/review-queue?status_filter=UNRESOLVED
    API->>DB: Fetch pending candidates
    DB-->>Desk: Return list of candidate items
    Desk->>Desk: Operator hits [Enter] or edits and hits [Ctrl+S]
    Desk->>API: PATCH /api/v1/review-queue/{queue_id} (action: ACCEPTED/EDITED)
    API->>DB: Update line item to verified & mark review resolved
    API-->>Desk: 200 OK (Auto-advances to next pending item)
```

## 6. Desktop Keyboard Ergonomics & Shortcuts Cheat Sheet

| Shortcut | Context | Action / Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Enter` / `Return` | Review Desk Table | 1-Click Approve active item (`action: "ACCEPTED"`) and auto-focus next row |
| `Ctrl + S` / `Cmd + S` | Review Desk Table | Save inline edits on candidate name, qty, or price (`action: "EDITED"`) |
| `Tab` | Review Desk Row | Advance focus between candidate item name, quantity, unit, and price fields |
| `Shift + Tab` | Review Desk Row | Move backward to previous field |
| `↑` / `↓` or `J` / `K` | Audit Ledger Grid | Select previous / next receipt row |
| `Space` | Audit Ledger Row | Open Slide-Out Inspector Drawer for selected receipt |
| `Esc` | Modal / Drawer | Dismiss Slide-Out Inspector Drawer or cancel inline editing |
| `/` (Forward Slash) | Global | Jump focus directly to Ingestion Ledger Search input |

### 7.4 Resolving a Review Queue Item
* **Endpoint:** `PATCH /api/v1/review-queue/{queue_id}`

```json

  "confirmed_name": "Sweet Melon",
  "action": "ACCEPTED"
}
```
* **Request Payload (Inline Edit & Correct):**
```json
{
  "confirmed_name": "Sweet Melon",
  "confirmed_quantity": 0.64,
  "confirmed_unit": "kg",
  "confirmed_unit_price": 199.0,
  "confirmed_total_price": 127.36,
  "action": "EDITED"
}
```

## 8. Design Aesthetic & Visual Constraints

1. **Rule #1: ZERO GRADIENTS.**
   Do not use multi-color gradient fills, rainbow accents, or glossy buttons. Use solid colors with crisp, deliberate contrast.
2. **Rule #2: ZERO GLASSMORPHISM / LIQUID GLASS.**
   Do not use frosted translucent blurs (`backdrop-filter: blur(...)`) or floating transparent cards. Use clean flat white/slate cards, solid 1px borders (`#CBD5E1`), and high legibility.
3. **Typography & Density:**
   * Body Font: `Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Inter`, or system UI fonts.
   * Monospace: `JetBrains Mono` or `Courier New` for numbers, IDs, and currency amounts.
   * Information Density: High density, compact padding, and tabular layouts suited for financial operators.

## 9. Development Quickstart & Testing Controls

1. **Start Backend API Gateway:**
   ```powershell
   cd backend
   .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
   ```
2. **Start Web Frontend:**
   ```bash
   cd web
   npm run dev
   ```
3. **Default Admin Login:**
   * **Email:** `user@receiptledger.com`
   * **Password:** `demo1234`
4. **Interactive Controls:**
   * `POST /api/v1/dashboard/seed-demo` - Instantly seeds 148 realistic receipts, line items, and pending review queue items.
   * `POST /api/v1/dashboard/reset` - Clears the ledger to test zero-data states and empty state illustrations.
